title: Statistical Ensemble Deviation Estimates for Nearly Integrable Hamiltonian Systems
summary: This paper studies quantitative deviation bounds for statistical ensembles evolving under the one-parameter flow of a nearly integrable Hamiltonian system. Combining Nekhoroshev-type stability estimates with phase-mixing arguments, we obtain, for any observable $G$, an explicit upper bound on the deviation of the ensemble average $\langle G\rangle_t$ from its angular average $\langle \left\langle G \right\rangle_θ\rangle_{0}$ over exponentially long time scales.
